posts.summary: The story of Resoloon really began for me about two and a half years ago with a simple, frustrating realization: satellite imagery was far too expensive. That moment was the spark; I knew there had to be a better way to get high-resolution intelligence. Of course later we identified that this is not that simple, but it was a great realization to start from.
